chunks: 1389 - And 'Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj narrated from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام:

That when he would rise at the end of the night, he would raise his voice until the people of the house could hear, and he would say: O Allah, help me against the terror of the ascenting place, make my resting place spacious for me, grant me the best of what is before death, and grant me the best of what is after death.

key_terms.آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ: the last part of the night, a time associated with worship and supplication
key_terms.الْمَضْجَعَ: the resting place, understood here as one's place of repose
key_terms.بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ: what comes after death, referring to the stages of the Hereafter
key_terms.قَبْلَ الْمَوْتِ: the period before death, referring to the closing portion of worldly life
key_terms.هَوْلِ الْمُطَّلَعِ: the terror of the moment of rising or exposure to the realities of the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: What supplication did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say when rising in the last part of the night?
ai.summary: This hadith records a supplication recited by Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام in the last part of the night. It expresses seeking Divine aid regarding the fear of the Hereafter, ease in the grave, and goodness before and after death, highlighting the spiritual importance of night worship and preparation for the afterlife.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1389 - Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj reports from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that when he would rise in the last part of the night, he would raise his voice such that the people of the household could hear and say:

Allahumma a‘inni ‘ala hawli al-muttala‘, wa wassi‘ ‘alayya al-madja‘, wa urzuqni khayra ma qabl al-mawt, wa urzuqni khayra ma ba‘d al-mawt
"O’ Allah (swt), help me with the terror of the Rising (on the Day of Judgment), make my resting place spacious, grant me the best of what comes before death, and grant me the best of what comes after death."
